description: The vs_standard label in the digest (OPF-SPEC §3.5.6, §3.12.2) and uncovered_clause_types. Signed variants labelled equivalent (three deals, two distinct texts; the respelled text merges under the grouping key) collapse into ONE entry with n_deals 3, n_texts 2, two exemplars and the concession count; the rest are listed individually in tier order: less_protective (two deals), different_concept, the unjudged one (a signed text with no label), more_protective, then the collapsed entry. positions counts signed deals by standard, each label and unjudged. The refused ask and the changed opening carry their labels. The taxonomy lists one covered entry, an active and a custom entry with no evidence (uncovered_clause_types, sorted by taxonomy_id) and an inactive entry (never listed).
